name: kbs
description: Discover, configure, retrieve from and deliberately build independent knowledge bases; install local session capture.

interface.shortDescription: Use and manage multiple independent KB services.
interface.longDescription: Routes retrieval across configured knowledge bases. Includes standard retrieval, idempotent setup with local session capture, and build orchestration using service-owned guidance. Capture routes feed human review independently of model instructions.
defaultPrompt: Run setup-kbs and reconcile my configured knowledge bases.
Use the relevant configured knowledge bases for this request.
Run build-kb for a knowledge base I choose.
